reviews.text: I cannot say enough great things about this company!   When we spoke with the owner, he was very clear about what they did the timeframe that they did it in and the cost. There was no hidden surprises. They showed up when they were supposed to come and finish the work when they were supposed to. They were extremely professional And you could tell that they really knew what they were doing. The job from start to finish was absolutely perfect. My husband had some issues with the air jet on s on our hot tub, and Rodrigo, the owner, came up with the solution for him. They went above and beyond.The outcome is gorgeous, even beyond our expectations! If I could enclose pictures, somehow I would. We live on a lake and we got the picture view screens installed and what a difference it makes! It looks like we are in a resort. We couldn't be happier. I highly highly highly recommend this company.
reviews.author: cookie colletti

reviews.text: Great company, fair prices, superlative communication! They’ve replaced my entire lanai screens, cleaned the frame and changed every screw in the structure.  Always on time, great work
reviews.author: Mitchell Group

reviews.text: What a great experience I had with Nice &Tight Pool Enclosures. Jeffrey was prompt on getting me an estimate and came to do the job 2 days later. Very pleased and would recommend this company.
reviews.author: Chuck Copley

reviews.text: From the moment Jeff arrived, I could tell the extensive repairs I needed were going to be handled very professionally.  He corrected mistakes previous handymen had made, solved problems others never pointed out and were thought were would just have to live with!  I can’t really speak to pricing.  It wasn’t handyman pricing for sure, but it wasn’t a handyman job either!  Highly recommend if you want the job done right!
reviews.author: Barbara Foster

reviews.text:
Excellent Patio Screen Replacement Service!

Recently Nice & Tight Pool replaced my patio screen, and I couldn’t be more pleased with the results! From start to finish, the team was professional, courteous, and efficient.

The quality of the materials they used is top-notch, and the installation was done with precision. They paid great attention to detail, ensuring that the new screen fits perfectly and enhances the overall look of my patio.

What impressed me most was their commitment to cleanliness and respect for my home—they left everything spotless after the job was done.

If you're looking for a reliable company to handle your patio screen replacement, I highly recommend Nice & Tide Pool. Their expertise and excellent customer service truly set them apart!
reviews.author: Karla Reis

reviews.text: They were prompt, efficient, courteous and they cleaned up after themselves. The work was done well and the price was reasonable.
reviews.author: Phil .Goldberg

reviews.text: Excellent work.  We have used this company twice and have always been every satisfied.   Heartily recommend.  You won't be disappointed.
reviews.author: Brent Browning

reviews.text: They are very professional and quick. I don’t have words to describe how grateful I am for the job they did at our apartment. I recommend Nice and Tight :)
reviews.author: Juliana Cavalcanti
